headline: Clinton order makes further changes to the rules for the President's Information Technology Advisory Committee.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13035, which set up a committee of outside experts to advise the President on information technology. The title says it makes further changes to that earlier order, which had already been amended once. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Information Technology Advisory Committee
who_it_affects.how: The rules that govern their advisory committee are changed in ways the title does not spell out.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 10, 1999; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
